toyota_etnga.nota: 0x1086 HV heater power: DRIVING only (>0 => v.e.heating)
0x10D4 batt power: AC+DC @1s (handler gated on charge-in-progress)
0x1684 AC op: WAIT slowed to 10s (was 1s); AC engage caught within 10s
0x1666 HLC: WAIT slowed to 10s (was 1s); DC re-engage caught within 10s
0x1F46 ambient via HCS: all charge @30s (A/C ambient is DRIVING-only)
0x161D grid power: AC+DC @5s (handler gated on AC charge)
0x1814 cell-temp array (Hybrid Battery ECU): AC @30s, DC @20s (AC added so batt_temp_c logs during AC charge)
